notes.title: Backyard Soccer ’98 Update Alert 🚨
notes.notes:
Hi-ho! We’ve rolled out a patch to further improve your experience


v.1.0.2

Steam Achievements are now fixed! Here’s the list of previously unattainable achievements:

 Shot Out - lose in a shoot out/penalty kick
 Round Table - score with every player in a game
 Oops - lose a season game
 Can Stop, Will Stop - lose 10 season games
 Goal Getter - score 10 goals (no longer triggered by opponents scoring goals)


Other fixes:

 Fixed window scaling issues on high DPI displays.
 Fixed a game launch issue with DEP enabled and resolved the glitchy cursor on high DPI displays.
 Steam Rich Presence - Your friends now see you're playing Backyard Soccer '98.


To make sure you’re playing the latest version, follow these steps to download the Steam update:
[olist]
Open the Steam application.
Click Library at the top.
Right-click on Backyard Soccer '98.
Select Properties from the drop-down menu.
Head to the Updates tab.
Choose how you’d like to update the game.
Steam will begin updating the game.
[/olist]


:warning: Note: While this patch continues to address some current issues, please remember that certain bugs from the original game may still exist. Without access to the original source code, some legacy problems remain beyond our control. But rest assured, we’re doing our best to make your experience as smooth as possible!


If you encounter any problems, we’d love to hear from you!

:point_right: Report a bug  here

Join our community on Discord

Thanks for your continued support, and let’s keep the fun going!
